svg.text: # Root Cause: Python memory allocator exceeded cgroup memory limit (20Mi) -> Linux Kernel OOM killer invoked

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: # Fix: Set container memory limits to 256Mi and requests to 128Mi

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: $ kubectl set resources pod fail-5-oomkilled-pod --limits=memory=256Mi --requests=memory=128Mi -n k8s-troubleshoot
